description: Requires techjobs.vn sign-in. Reads the sections of the user's primary CV (or of another of their CVs by cv_id): language, name, contact details, headline, summary, experience, projects, achievements, skills, education, certifications, languages, in the shape update_cv_variant takes. Read a CV with this before rewriting it with update_cv_variant.

cv_id.description: Id of one of the user's other CVs, from list_my_cvs. Omit to read the primary CV.

name: get_cv
title: Read one of my CVs
